description: A shapeless one-piece coverall in Precinct 9 orange, the paper-thin fabric stamped DETAINEE across the back in stencilled block letters. It zips from crotch to throat and covers you from shoulders to shins in a single miserable garment. It fits nobody and smells of institutional bleach.
name: prison jumpsuit
